name: Commercial tenant isolation
verification: Tenant A cannot view or mutate Tenant B plans-as-applied, billing, usage, entitlements, branding or support data.

name: Financial admin roles
verification: Credits/refunds/write-offs/price overrides require scoped commercial roles and configured approvals.

name: Payment data minimization
verification: Do not store restricted payment credential data when provider tokens/references suffice.

name: Billing PII protection
verification: Billing contacts, addresses, tax identifiers and payment metadata follow classification/privacy policy.

name: Entitlement authorization
verification: Entitlement checks cannot substitute for identity/authorization; both must pass.

name: Usage event authentication
verification: Metered usage ingestion authenticates trusted producers and validates tenant/resource scope.

name: Webhook security
verification: Commercial webhooks use signing, replay protection and destination governance.

name: Custom domain security
verification: Domain ownership and certificate status are validated before activation.

name: White-label safe fields
verification: Brand customization is allowlisted/sanitized and cannot inject unsafe executable content.

name: Partner isolation
verification: Partners access only explicitly assigned tenants/resources and cannot infer other customer data.

name: Support access control
verification: Support impersonation/elevated access uses audited privileged workflows.

name: Commercial audit integrity
verification: Commercial audit/evidence is protected from ordinary mutation.

name: Secrets separation
verification: Payment/tax/email/domain-provider secrets use managed secrets and environment separation.

name: Export control
verification: Invoice/customer/commercial exports apply classification, permission and audit controls.

name: Fraud/abuse signals
verification: Suspicious trial, promotion, usage and payment patterns can trigger review without weakening due process controls.

name: Data retention
verification: Commercial/financial retention and deletion follows legal, tax, privacy and contractual policy.

name: API/admin rate controls
verification: Commercial admin/API surfaces use security rate limiting independent from sellable API quotas.

name: Incident correction safety
verification: Commercial incidents use bounded correction workflows with reconciliation and rollback/compensation evidence.
